summary: Tested the hallucination fix for the chess coaching app. All 32 backend tests passed covering BLOCKED_BISHOP_BY_OWN_PAWN rule fixes (early opening check, starting square check), LLM prompt FEN inclusion, and opening detection. All 11 frontend E2E tests for Play with Coach passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All hallucination fixes verified: 1) BLOCKED_BISHOP_BY_OWN_PAWN rule now has early opening check (move_number < 6) and starting square check (c1, f1, c8, f8). 2) LLM prompts include FEN and explicit instructions to verify piece positions. 3) Opening detection requires minimum moves (e.g., Italian Game needs 5 moves). Play with Coach E2E flow works correctly.

backend: BLOCKED_BISHOP_BY_OWN_PAWN rule - early opening check (moves 1-5 do not trigger)
BLOCKED_BISHOP_BY_OWN_PAWN rule - starting square check (c1, f1, c8, f8 bishops not flagged)
BLOCKED_BISHOP_BY_OWN_PAWN rule - developed bishops CAN be flagged
